systems.name: auditarchiver
systems.function: Export audit logs to S3 in Parquet format using Apache Arrow

decisions.detail: Keep last 90 days of audit_log data in hot storage; archive older data to S3 in Parquet format
Partition audit_log table by created_at month
Migrating from legacy MySQL 5.7 schema to Postgres 16

blockers.details: auditarchiver leaks goroutines under load (40k goroutines after 6 hours)
blockers.suspected_cause: Missing context cancellation in the parquet writer
